key.name: api-key
key.description: Your personal API token from https://api.esv.org. Create a free account and generate a token under API Tokens.

key.name: show-verse-in-panel
key.summary: Show verse snippet in the panel
key.description: When enabled, a short snippet of the current verse reference and text is displayed beside the icon in the top panel bar.

key.name: auto-refresh-minutes
key.description: How often (in minutes) the extension automatically advances to the next verse in the list. Set to 0 to disable auto-refresh.

key.name: custom-verses
key.description: A list of Bible passage references (e.g. "John 3:16") to cycle through. When empty the built-in default list is used.
